difficulty_reason: H2: For an arbitrary algebraic stack, identify the affine-site cartesian-object category QC(X) with D_QCoh(O_X). The counted author proof1316-1419 places both inside D(X_fppf,O), proves flat base-change/locally quasi-coherent cohomology for Q_X, uses local derived-Hom evaluation and parasitic vanishing to prove Q_X is left orthogonal to the parasitic subcategory, and proves the reverse inclusion using the image of Lg_! and the higher-shriek comparison. This three-step identification is the actual comparison argument. Original QC/cartesian/parasitic/flat-base-change definitions and the author colocalization/higher-shriek context are supplied natively; none is inferred from a new label alone.

dedup.basis: The new category QC(X) consists of affine-site cartesian derived objects for arbitrary algebraic stacks. Existing579 compares a chaotic topology with a finer topology only under a cartesianity hypothesis; existing2750 is a conditional qcqs-scheme comparison D(QCoh)→D_QCoh with a derived-open-pushforward compatibility condition. Their actual hypotheses and domains differ from this stack statement.
